content.short: Stacks brings smart contracts and BTC yield to Bitcoin, anchored with Proof of Transfer and home to sBTC.
content.description: Stacks records its state on Bitcoin through a consensus method called Proof of Transfer, and STX holders who stack their tokens earn BTC. Smart contracts are written in Clarity, a language designed to be readable and predictable, and they are able to see what is happening on Bitcoin itself. The Nakamoto upgrade brought faster blocks and sBTC, a BTC-backed asset that lets bitcoin move into Stacks DeFi. Self-custodial bitcoin staking is now live, and developers build with Clarinet, a local toolkit for writing and testing Clarity contracts.
content.meta: Bitcoin smart contract layer with Clarity, Proof of Transfer and BTC-backed sBTC. Explore Stacks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
